issues: The translation is not always accurate, e.g. "UI automation across those three worlds" is translated as "UI автоматтандыру әдетте" ("usually"), which is not the same meaning. The phrase "the real bar" is not translated at all. The translation also contains some unnatural phrasing, e.g. "бастапқы элементтер" ("primitives") and "Қиын мәселелер" ("The hard problems").
